          <div>
            <strong>Unbiased Scientific Evaluation Active</strong>
            <p>Gender-neutral scale-invariant pitch variance ($CV_{`{F0}`}$), normalized conversational speech rate (120-160 WPM), and objective pause timing thresholds.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="unbiased-pills">
          <span className="algo-badge"><Activity size={12} /> Prosodic RMS Energy</span>
          <span className="algo-badge"><TrendingUp size={12} /> Adaptive Noise Floor</span>
          <span className="algo-badge"><Award size={12} /> Standardized Baseline</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Hero Master Audio & Extraction Overview */}
      <div className="audio-master-card">
        <div className="master-header-row">
          <div className="audio-badge-active">
            <Radio size={14} className="pulse-icon" />
            <span>Master 16kHz WAV Audio Extracted</span>
          </div>
          <div className="master-actions">
            <a
              href={getFullAudioSrc(displayAudio.masterAudioUrl)}
              download="master_audio.wav"
              className="download-btn-pill"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
            >
              <Download size={14} /> Download WAV
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="master-player-wrapper">
          <div className="player-meta-left">
            <Volume2 size={24} className="audio-accent-icon" />
            <div>
              <div className="master-track-title">Master Video Audio Track</div>
              <div className="master-track-sub">Uncompressed mono 16,000 Hz • Full Meeting Recording</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <audio
            controls
            src={getFullAudioSrc(displayAudio.masterAudioUrl)}
            className="native-audio-player"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Stats Row */}
        <div className="audio-stats-grid">
          <div className="audio-stat-pill">
            <Clock size={16} />
            <div>
              <div className="stat-label">Total Duration</div>
              <div className="stat-value">{displayAudio.totalDurationFormatted}</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="audio-stat-pill">
            <Mic size={16} />
            <div>
              <div className="stat-label">Total Spoken Speech</div>
              <div className="stat-value">{displayAudio.totalSpeechSec}s</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="audio-stat-pill">
            <Headphones size={16} />
            <div>
              <div className="stat-label">Silence Filtered</div>
              <div className="stat-value">{displayAudio.silenceDurationSec}s ({displayAudio.silencePercentage}%)</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="audio-stat-pill">
            <Sparkles size={16} />
            <div>
              <div className="stat-label">Speakers Isolated</div>
              <div className="stat-value">{displayAudio.speakerCount} Distinct Voices</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Section 1: Extracted User Voice Profiles (According to Their Names) */}
      <div className="section-container">
        <div className="section-header">
          <div className="section-title-wrap">
            <Mic size={20} className="section-title-icon" />
            <h2>Extracted Audio by Users & Names</h2>
          </div>
          <span className="section-subtitle">
            Individual voice tracks separated per speaker so you can listen to and analyze each user independently.
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="speaker-cards-grid">
          {displayAudio.speakers.map((spk, idx) => {
            const color = speakerColorMap[idx % speakerColorMap.length];
            const isPlaying = activePlayingUrl === getFullAudioSrc(spk.fullAudioUrl);
            const ana = spk.analytics || {};

            return (
              <div className="speaker-card" key={spk.id} style={{ borderTop: `3px solid ${color}` }}>
                <div className="speaker-card-header">
                  <div className="speaker-avatar" style={{ backgroundColor: `${color}20`, color: color }}>
                    {getDisplayName(spk).charAt(0)}
                  </div>
                  <div className="speaker-identity">
                    {editingSpkId === spk.id ? (
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        style={{
                          background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                          border: '1px solid var(--primary-accent)',
                          borderRadius: '4px',
                          color: '#fff',
                          fontSize: '0.9rem',
                          fontWeight: 600,
                          padding: '2px 6px',
                          outline: 'none',
                          maxWidth: '180px'
                        }}
                        value={editingSpkName}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditingSpkName(e.target.value)}
                        onBlur={() => {
                          if (editingSpkName.trim()) {
                            setCustomSpeakerNames(prev => ({ ...prev, [spk.id]: editingSpkName.trim() }));
                          }
                          setEditingSpkId(null);
                        }}
                        onKeyDown={(e) => {
                          if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                            if (editingSpkName.trim()) {
                              setCustomSpeakerNames(prev => ({ ...prev, [spk.id]: editingSpkName.trim() }));
                            }
                            setEditingSpkId(null);
                          }
                        }}
                        autoFocus
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <div
                        className="speaker-name"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setEditingSpkId(spk.id);
                          setEditingSpkName(getDisplayName(spk));
                        }}
                        title="Click to rename speaker"
                        style={{ cursor: 'pointer', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' }}
                      >
                        <span>{getDisplayName(spk)}</span>
                        <Edit2 size={12} style={{ opacity: 0.5 }} />
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <span className="speaker-role-tag">{spk.role} • {spk.id}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="speaker-percentage-badge" style={{ backgroundColor: `${color}15`, color: color }}>
                    {spk.speakingPercentage}%
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="speaker-stats-row">
                  <div>
                    <span className="mini-label">Total Spoken:</span>
                    <strong className="mini-value">{spk.formattedSpokenTime} ({spk.totalSpokenSec}s)</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="mini-label">Turns:</span>
                    <strong className="mini-value">{spk.turnCount} times</strong>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Algorithmic Metrics Bar */}
                <div className="speaker-analytics-chips">
                  <span className="ana-chip">
                    <strong>{ana.wpm || 135}</strong> WPM
                  </span>
                  <span className="ana-chip">
                    <strong>{ana.fillerWords || 1}</strong> Fillers
                  </span>
                  <span className={`ana-chip-sentiment ${getSentimentClass(ana.sentiment || 'Positive')}`}>
                    {ana.sentiment || 'Positive'}
                  </span>
                  <span className="ana-chip-emotion">
                    {ana.emotion || 'Confident'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Percentage Visual Bar */}
                <div className="speaking-bar-track">
                  <div
                    className="speaking-bar-fill"
                    style={{ width: `${Math.min(spk.speakingPercentage, 100)}%`, backgroundColor: color }}
                  ></div>
                </div>

                {/* Dedicated Audio Player for this Speaker's Isolated Voice */}
                <div className="speaker-audio-box">
                  <div className="audio-box-header">
                    <div className="audio-box-title">
                      <Volume2 size={14} />
                      <span>Isolated Voice Track ({spk.name})</span>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={`quick-play-btn ${isPlaying ? 'playing' : ''}`}
                      onClick={() => handlePlayToggle(spk.fullAudioUrl)}
                      title="Quick Play Speaker Voice"
                    >
                      {isPlaying ? <Pause size={14} /> : <Play size={14} />}
                      <span>{isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play Voice'}</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <audio
                    controls
                    src={getFullAudioSrc(spk.fullAudioUrl)}
                    className="speaker-audio-element"
                  />
                </div>

                {/* AI Communication Coach Quick Launch */}
                <div className="speaker-card-actions">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="speaker-coach-btn"
                    onClick={() => handleOpenCoach(spk)}
                  >
                    <Sparkles size={14} />
                    <span>AI Communication Coach</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Section 2: "Who Spoke When" Chronological Timeline */}
      <div className="section-container">
        <div className="section-header">
          <div className="section-title-wrap">
            <Clock size={20} className="section-title-icon" />
            <h2>Who Spoke When — Chronological Audio Timeline</h2>
          </div>
          <span className="section-subtitle">
            Accurate speech turns with exact millisecond timestamps and extracted turn-by-turn audio slices.
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="timeline-container">
          {displayAudio.timeline.map((turn, tIdx) => {
            const spkIndex = parseInt(turn.speakerId.replace('SPEAKER_', '')) - 1 || 0;
            const color = speakerColorMap[spkIndex % speakerColorMap.length];
            const isPlayingTurn = activePlayingUrl === getFullAudioSrc(turn.audioUrl);

            return (
              <div className="timeline-turn-item" key={turn.turnIndex || tIdx}>
                <div className="timeline-turn-left">
                  <div className="turn-number-badge">#{turn.turnIndex}</div>
                  <div className="turn-timestamp-pill">
                    <Clock size={12} />
                    <span>{turn.start} — {turn.end}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="timeline-turn-middle">
                  <div className="turn-speaker-pill" style={{ backgroundColor: `${color}15`, color: color, borderColor: `${color}40` }}>
                    <span className="turn-dot" style={{ backgroundColor: color }}></span>
                    <strong>{customSpeakerNames[turn.speakerId] || turn.speakerName}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <span className="turn-duration-text">Duration: {turn.duration}s</span>
                </div>

                <div className="timeline-turn-right">
                  <audio
                    controls
                    src={getFullAudioSrc(turn.audioUrl)}
                    className="turn-audio-player"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className={`turn-play-btn ${isPlayingTurn ? 'playing' : ''}`}
                    onClick={() => handlePlayToggle(turn.audioUrl)}
                    title="Play turn snippet"
                  >
                    {isPlayingTurn ? <Pause size={14} /> : <Play size={14} />}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Section 3: Comprehensive Communication & Behavioral Analysis Table */}
      <div className="section-container">
        <div className="section-header">
          <div className="section-title-wrap">
            <Sparkles size={20} className="section-title-icon" />
            <h2>Communication & Psychological Behavioral Scores</h2>
          </div>
          <span className="section-subtitle">
            Multimodal evaluation derived from acoustic fluency, cadence, awkwardness, and sentiment.
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="analysis-table-wrapper">
          <table className="analysis-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>User Names</th>
                <th>Communication Skills</th>
                <th>Communication Fluency</th>
                <th>Awkwardness</th>
                <th>Facial Expression</th>
                <th>Leadership Quality</th>
                <th>Dominance</th>
                <th>Sentiment Analysis</th>
                <th>Emotion</th>
                <th>Total Score</th>
                <th>AI Coaching</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {participants.map((p, idx) => (
                <tr key={idx}>
                  <td className="participant-name-cell">
                    <div>{p.name}</div>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>{p.wpm} WPM</span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div className={`score-cell ${getScoreClass(p.communication)}`}>
                      <div className="score-bar-track">
                        <div className="score-bar-fill" style={{ width: `${p.communication * 10}%` }}></div>
                      </div>
                      <span>{p.communication}/10</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div className={`score-cell ${getScoreClass(p.fluency)}`}>
                      <div className="score-bar-track">
                        <div className="score-bar-fill" style={{ width: `${p.fluency * 10}%` }}></div>
                      </div>
                      <span>{p.fluency}/10</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div className={`score-cell ${getAwkwardClass(p.awkwardness)}`}>
                      <div className="score-bar-track">
                        <div className="score-bar-fill" style={{ width: `${p.awkwardness * 10}%` }}></div>
                      </div>
                      <span>{p.awkwardness}/10</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div className={`score-cell ${getScoreClass(p.facial)}`}>
                      <div className="score-bar-track">
                        <div className="score-bar-fill" style={{ width: `${p.facial * 10}%` }}></div>
                      </div>
                      <span>{p.facial}/10</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div className={`score-cell ${getScoreClass(p.leadership)}`}>
                      <div className="score-bar-track">
                        <div className="score-bar-fill" style={{ width: `${p.leadership * 10}%` }}></div>
                      </div>
                      <span>{p.leadership}/10</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div className={`score-cell ${getScoreClass(p.dominance)}`}>
                      <div className="score-bar-track">
                        <div className="score-bar-fill" style={{ width: `${p.dominance * 10}%` }}></div>
                      </div>
                      <span>{p.dominance}/10</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div className={`sentiment-badge ${getSentimentClass(p.sentiment)}`}>
                      {getSentimentIcon(p.sentiment)}
                      <span>{p.sentiment}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div className={`emotion-badge ${getEmotionClass(p.emotion)}`}>
                      <span>{p.emotion}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div className={`total-score-badge ${getScoreClass(p.total)}`}>
                      {p.total}/10
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="table-coach-btn"
                      onClick={() => handleOpenCoach(displayAudio.speakers[idx])}
                      title="Open AI Communication Coaching"
                    >
                      <Sparkles size={13} />
                      <span>Coach</span>
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* AI Communication Coaching Modal */}
      {coachModalOpen && (
        <div className="coach-modal-backdrop" onClick={() => setCoachModalOpen(false)}>
          <div className="coach-modal-container" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            {/* Modal Header */}
            <div className="coach-modal-header">
              <div className="coach-header-left">
                <div className="coach-icon-badge">
                  <Sparkles size={20} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="coach-header-title">
                    AI Communication Coach: {selectedCoachSpeaker ? getDisplayName(selectedCoachSpeaker) : 'Speaker'}
                  </div>
                  <div className="coach-header-subtitle">
                    Evidence-based behavioral evaluation across 7 calibrated communication dimensions
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="coach-close-btn"
                onClick={() => setCoachModalOpen(false)}
                aria-label="Close Coaching Modal"
              >
                <X size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Body */}
            <div className="coach-modal-body">
              {loadingCoach ? (
                <div className="coach-loading-state">
                  <Loader2 size={38} className="coach-spinner" />
                  <h4>Evaluating Observable Communication Behaviors...</h4>
                  <p>Analyzing speech cadence, active listening, lexical precision, and grounding verbatim evidence.</p>
                </div>
              ) : coachError ? (
                <div className="coach-error-state">
                  <AlertCircle size={32} />
                  <p>{coachError}</p>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => handleOpenCoach(selectedCoachSpeaker)}>
                    Retry Evaluation
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : coachingReport ? (
                <div className="coach-content-grid">
                  {/* Hero Metric & Coverage Banner */}
                  <div className="coach-hero-banner">
                    <div className="coach-overall-score-card">
                      <div className="coach-score-circle">
                        <span className="coach-score-number">{coachingReport.overall_score ?? 'N/A'}</span>
                        <span className="coach-score-max">/ 100</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="coach-overall-meta">
                        <div className="coach-grade-tag">
                          {coachingReport.overall_score >= 85 ? 'Exemplary Executive Presence' :
                           coachingReport.overall_score >= 75 ? 'Strong Professional Presence' :
                           coachingReport.overall_score >= 60 ? 'Developing Communicator' : 'Needs Structured Coaching'}
                        </div>
                        <div className="coach-coverage-tag">
                          Evidence Coverage: <strong>{coachingReport.evidence_coverage?.level?.toUpperCase() || 'HIGH'}</strong>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="coach-quick-metrics">
                      <div className="coach-metric-item">
                        <span className="metric-label">Speaking Pacing</span>
                        <span className="metric-val">{coachingReport.metrics?.words_per_minute || 135} WPM</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="coach-metric-item">
                        <span className="metric-label">Word Count</span>
                        <span className="metric-val">{coachingReport.metrics?.word_count || 0} words</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="coach-metric-item">
                        <span className="metric-label">Speaking Turns</span>
                        <span className="metric-val">{coachingReport.metrics?.speaking_turn_count || 0} turns</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="coach-metric-item">
                        <span className="metric-label">Hesitation Fillers</span>
                        <span className="metric-val">{coachingReport.metrics?.filler_word_count ?? 0}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* 7 Calibrated Rubric Category Scores */}
                  <div className="coach-categories-section">
                    <h3 className="coach-subheading">
                      <Award size={16} /> 7-Dimension Calibrated Rubric Breakdown
                    </h3>
                    <div className="coach-rubric-grid">
                      {[
                        { key: 'verbal_clarity', label: 'Verbal Clarity', weight: '20%' },
                        { key: 'speaking_fluency', label: 'Speaking Fluency', weight: '15%' },
                        { key: 'vocabulary_and_expression', label: 'Vocabulary & Expression', weight: '15%' },
                        { key: 'explanation_and_presentation', label: 'Explanation & Presentation', weight: '15%' },
                        { key: 'active_listening_and_responsiveness', label: 'Active Listening & Responsiveness', weight: '15%' },
                        { key: 'professional_communication', label: 'Professional Communication', weight: '10%' },
                        { key: 'conciseness_and_structure', label: 'Conciseness & Structure', weight: '10%' },
                      ].map((item) => {
                        const val = coachingReport.category_scores?.[item.key];
                        return (
                          <div className="coach-rubric-card" key={item.key}>
                            <div className="rubric-card-header">
                              <span className="rubric-label">{item.label}</span>
                              <span className="rubric-weight">Weight: {item.weight}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="rubric-score-row">
                              <div className="rubric-bar-track">
                                <div
                                  className="rubric-bar-fill"
                                  style={{
                                    width: `${val || 0}%`,
                                    backgroundColor: (val || 0) >= 80 ? '#10B981' : (val || 0) >= 65 ? '#3B82F6' : '#F59E0B'
                                  }}
                                ></div>
                              </div>
                              <span className="rubric-number">{val !== null ? `${val}/100` : 'N/A'}</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Observable Strengths & Improvement Areas Side-by-Side */}
                  <div className="coach-findings-columns">
                    {/* Strengths */}
                    <div className="coach-findings-box strengths">
                      <h4 className="findings-title">
                        <CheckCircle size={16} className="text-emerald" /> Observed Communication Strengths
                      </h4>
                      {coachingReport.strengths?.length > 0 ? (
                        coachingReport.strengths.map((str, sIdx) => (
                          <div className="finding-card strength" key={sIdx}>
                            <div className="finding-card-header">
                              <strong className="finding-title">{str.title}</strong>
                              {str.timestamp && <span className="finding-timestamp">[{str.timestamp}]</span>}
                            </div>
                            <p className="finding-explanation">{str.explanation}</p>
                            {str.evidence_quote && (
                              <div className="finding-quote">
                                <Quote size={12} className="quote-icon" />
                                <em>"{str.evidence_quote}"</em>
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        ))
                      ) : (
                        <p className="empty-findings">No evidence-grounded strengths detected in current audio sample.</p>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Improvement Areas */}
                    <div className="coach-findings-box improvements">
                      <h4 className="findings-title">
                        <Target size={16} className="text-amber" /> Targeted Growth Areas & Rephrasing
                      </h4>
                      {coachingReport.improvement_areas?.length > 0 ? (
                        coachingReport.improvement_areas.map((imp, iIdx) => (
                          <div className="finding-card improvement" key={iIdx}>
                            <div className="finding-card-header">
                              <strong className="finding-title">{imp.title}</strong>
                              {imp.timestamp && <span className="finding-timestamp">[{imp.timestamp}]</span>}
                            </div>
                            <p className="finding-explanation">{imp.explanation}</p>
                            {imp.evidence_quote && (
                              <div className="finding-quote">
                                <Quote size={12} className="quote-icon" />
                                <em>"{imp.evidence_quote}"</em>
                              </div>
                            )}
                            {imp.suggested_improvement && (
                              <div className="finding-suggested">
                                <span className="suggested-tag">Suggested Rephrasing:</span>
                                <span>{imp.suggested_improvement}</span>
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        ))
                      ) : (
                        <p className="empty-findings">No severe communication deficiencies detected.</p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Practice Plan */}
                  {coachingReport.practice_plan?.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="coach-practice-section">
                      <h4 className="findings-title">
                        <BookOpen size={16} className="text-indigo" /> Individualized Practice Drills & Goals
                      </h4>
                      <div className="practice-grid">
                        {coachingReport.practice_plan.map((plan, pIdx) => (
                          <div className="practice-card" key={pIdx}>
                            <div className="practice-skill-badge">{plan.skill}</div>
                            <div className="practice-exercise">
                              <strong>Exercise:</strong> {plan.exercise}
                            </div>
                            <div className="practice-goal">
                              <strong>Measurable Target:</strong> {plan.measurable_goal}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Executive Feedback Box */}
                  {coachingReport.overall_feedback && (
                    <div className="coach-feedback-box">
                      <div className="feedback-header">
                        <Compass size={16} /> Executive Coach Synthesis
                      </div>
                      <p className="feedback-text">{coachingReport.overall_feedback}</p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}

export default AnalysisReport;

import { auth } from './firebase';
import MeetingDashboard from './MeetingDashboard';

export default function AnalysisReport({ videoTitle, audioData, onBack }) {
  const dynamicHost = audioData?.hostName ||
    audioData?.speakers?.speaker_0 ||
    auth?.currentUser?.displayName ||
    (auth?.currentUser?.email ? auth.currentUser.email.split('@')[0] : 'Host');

  const dynamicGuest = audioData?.guestName ||
    audioData?.speakers?.speaker_1 ||
    (Array.isArray(audioData?.participantNames) && audioData.participantNames[0]) ||
    'Participant';

  return (
    <MeetingDashboard
      videoTitle={videoTitle}
      initialData={audioData}
      meetingId={audioData?.meetingId || audioData?.meetingCode}
      hostName={dynamicHost}
      guestName={dynamicGuest}
      onBack={onBack}
    />
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Video,
  Upload,
  Play,

  Moon,
  Sun,
  LogOut,
  Calendar,
  Clock,
  BarChart2,
  AlertCircle,

  ChevronRight,

  Smartphone,
