  ShieldAlert,
  Search,
  Sparkles,
  Users,
  MessageSquare,
  BarChart2,
  Award,
  RefreshCw,
  FileText,
  Loader2,
  Zap,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  ShieldCheck,
  UploadCloud
} from 'lucide-react';
import jsPDF from 'jspdf';
import html2canvas from 'html2canvas';
import {
  subscribeToMeetingDocument,
  fetchMeetingDocument,
  subscribeToTranscript,
  fetchMeetingTranscript,
  triggerAuditMeetingFactCheck,
  uploadMeetingVideoToFirebase,
  triggerGenerateMeetingTranscription,
  auth,
  getCurrentAuthUser
} from './firebase';
import './MeetingDashboard.css';

/**
 * Metric Configuration for the 5 Gemini Evaluated Parameters (1-10)
 */
const METRICS_CONFIG = [
  {
    key: 'communication_skills',
    label: 'Communication Skills',
    fillClass: 'fill-skills',
    invert: false,
    desc: 'Clarity, articulation & structural coherence'
  },
  {
    key: 'fluency',
    label: 'Communication Fluency',
    fillClass: 'fill-fluency',
    invert: false,
    desc: 'Cadence, natural pace & minimal hesitation'
  },
  {
    key: 'confidence',
    label: 'Confidence',
    fillClass: 'fill-confidence',
    invert: false,
    desc: 'Tone assertiveness & executive presence'
  },
  {
    key: 'awkwardness',
    label: 'Awkwardness',
    fillClass: 'fill-awkwardness',
    invert: true, // Lower awkwardness is better!
    desc: 'Hesitation or tension (lower is better)'
  },
  {
    key: 'straightforward_answers',
    label: 'Straightforward Answers',
    fillClass: 'fill-straightforward',
    invert: false,
    desc: 'Directness & avoidance of evasive phrasing'
  }
];

function generateUniqueMeetingId() {
  const randomSuffix = typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID
    ? crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)
    : Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10);
  return `meeting_${Date.now()}_${randomSuffix}`;
}

export default function MeetingDashboard({
  meetingId,
  initialData = null,
  videoTitle = '',
  hostName: propHostName = '',
  guestName: propGuestName = '',
  onBack
}) {
  // 1. Dynamic Meeting ID Generation Fix:
  // Completely remove the static/hardcoded ID 'meeting_default'.
  // Generate a unique random ID for every session.
  const [activeMeetingId, setActiveMeetingId] = useState(() => {
    const raw = meetingId || initialData?.meetingId || initialData?.meetingCode;
    if (raw && raw !== 'meeting_default' && raw !== 'default') {
      return String(raw);
    }
    return generateUniqueMeetingId();
  });

  const cleanMeetingId = activeMeetingId;

  // Local component states initialized cleanly for the active meeting
  const [meetingDoc, setMeetingDoc] = useState(() => {
    if (initialData && initialData.meetingId === cleanMeetingId && initialData.meetingId !== 'meeting_default') {
      return initialData;
    }
    return { meetingId: cleanMeetingId };
  });
  const [transcriptDoc, setTranscriptDoc] = useState({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedAuditFilter, setSelectedAuditFilter] = useState('all');
  const [copiedTranscript, setCopiedTranscript] = useState(false);
  const [isAuditing, setIsAuditing] = useState(false);
  const [isExportingPdf, setIsExportingPdf] = useState(false);
  const [auditNotice, setAuditNotice] = useState('');
  const reportContainerRef = useRef(null);
  const dialogueEndRef = useRef(null);

  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);
  const [transcriptionStatus, setTranscriptionStatus] = useState(() => {
    return initialData?.transcriptionStatus || initialData?.ratingsStatus || 'idle';
  });

  const [isUploadingVideo, setIsUploadingVideo] = useState(false);
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(0);
  const [uploadStatus, setUploadStatus] = useState('');
  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);

  // Sync when parent prop changes to a new non-default meeting ID
  useEffect(() => {
    if (meetingId && meetingId !== 'meeting_default' && meetingId !== activeMeetingId) {
      setActiveMeetingId(String(meetingId));
      // Absolute Cache Purge
      setMeetingDoc({
        meetingId: String(meetingId),
        rawTranscript: null,
        transcriptText: null,
        dialogueTurns: [],
        segments: [],
        speakerRatings: null,
        factCheckAudit: [],
        summary: null,
        meetingSummary: null,
        transcriptionStatus: 'processing',
        ratingsStatus: 'processing',
        factCheckStatus: 'processing'
      });
      setTranscriptDoc({});
      setCurrentStep(1);
      setTranscriptionStatus('processing');
      setLoading(true);
    }
  }, [meetingId]);

  // Dynamic Identity Injection:
  // Capture authenticated user identity at session moment and roster metadata
  const currentAuth = getCurrentAuthUser() || auth?.currentUser;
  const authUserName = currentAuth?.displayName || (currentAuth?.email ? currentAuth.email.split('@')[0] : null);

  const hostName = useMemo(() => {
    const candidate =
      meetingDoc?.hostName ||
      initialData?.hostName ||
      propHostName ||
      authUserName ||
      'ABHIGOWDA819761';
    return candidate && candidate !== 'Host' && candidate !== 'James' ? candidate : (authUserName || 'ABHIGOWDA819761');
  }, [meetingDoc, initialData, propHostName, authUserName]);

  const guestName = useMemo(() => {
    const candidate =
      meetingDoc?.guestName ||
      (Array.isArray(meetingDoc?.participantNames) && meetingDoc.participantNames[0]) ||
      (meetingDoc?.participants && (meetingDoc.participants[0]?.name || meetingDoc.participants[0])) ||
      (Array.isArray(initialData?.participantNames) && initialData.participantNames[0]) ||
      initialData?.guestName ||
      propGuestName ||
      'Participant';
    return candidate && candidate !== 'Hassassin' && candidate !== 'Guest' ? candidate : 'Participant';
  }, [meetingDoc, initialData, propGuestName]);

  // 1. Real-time Firestore Listeners: Track meetings/{cleanMeetingId} & transcripts/{cleanMeetingId}
  // As soon as transcriptionStatus or ratingsStatus switches to 'completed', instantly clear loading
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!cleanMeetingId) return;

    let isSubscribed = true;

    // Initial snapshot fetch
    fetchMeetingDocument(cleanMeetingId).then((data) => {
      if (!isSubscribed) return;
      if (data && (!data.meetingId || data.meetingId === cleanMeetingId)) {
        setMeetingDoc((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...data }));
        if (data.transcriptionStatus === 'completed' || data.ratingsStatus === 'completed' || data.transcriptStatus === 'completed') {
          setCurrentStep(4);
          setTranscriptionStatus('completed');
          setLoading(false);
          setIsUploadingVideo(false);
        }
      }
    }).catch(() => {}).finally(() => {
      if (isSubscribed && (transcriptionStatus === 'completed' || meetingDoc?.transcriptionStatus === 'completed')) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    });

    fetchMeetingTranscript(cleanMeetingId).then((data) => {
      if (!isSubscribed) return;
      if (data && (!data.meetingId || data.meetingId === cleanMeetingId)) {
        setTranscriptDoc((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...data }));
        if (data.status === 'completed') {
          setCurrentStep(4);
          setTranscriptionStatus('completed');
          setLoading(false);
          setIsUploadingVideo(false);
        }
      }
    }).catch(() => {});

    // Subscribe in real-time to meetings collection for this specific dynamic ID
    const unsubMeeting = subscribeToMeetingDocument(cleanMeetingId, (updated) => {
      if (!isSubscribed) return;
      if (updated && (!updated.meetingId || updated.meetingId === cleanMeetingId)) {
        setMeetingDoc((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updated }));
        // As soon as transcriptionStatus or ratingsStatus switches to 'completed', instantly clear loading
        if (updated.transcriptionStatus === 'completed' || updated.ratingsStatus === 'completed' || updated.transcriptStatus === 'completed') {
          setCurrentStep(4);
          setTranscriptionStatus('completed');
          setLoading(false);
          setIsUploadingVideo(false);
        }
      }
    });

    // Subscribe in real-time to transcripts collection for this specific dynamic ID
    const unsubTranscript = subscribeToTranscript(cleanMeetingId, (updated) => {
      if (!isSubscribed) return;
      if (updated && (!updated.meetingId || updated.meetingId === cleanMeetingId)) {
        setTranscriptDoc((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...updated }));
        if (updated.status === 'completed') {
          setCurrentStep(4);
          setTranscriptionStatus('completed');
          setLoading(false);
          setIsUploadingVideo(false);
        }
      }
    });

    return () => {
      isSubscribed = false;
      unsubMeeting();
      unsubTranscript();
    };
  }, [cleanMeetingId]);

  const isProcessing = useMemo(() => {
    // Instantly clear loading overlay view entirely and unmount spinner component if completed
    const mTransStatus = transcriptionStatus || meetingDoc?.transcriptionStatus;
    const mRateStatus = meetingDoc?.ratingsStatus;
    const mDocStatus = meetingDoc?.transcriptStatus;
    const tDocStatus = transcriptDoc?.status;

    const isCompleted =
      mTransStatus === 'completed' ||
      mRateStatus === 'completed' ||
      mDocStatus === 'completed' ||
      tDocStatus === 'completed';

    if (isCompleted) {
      return false;
    }

    if (mTransStatus === 'failed' || mRateStatus === 'failed') {
      return false;
    }

    // If actively uploading video or running pipeline
    if (isUploadingVideo || loading) return true;

    if (mTransStatus === 'processing' || mTransStatus === 'analyzing' || tDocStatus === 'processing') {
      return true;
    }

    // If session is idle or awaiting video selection, do not block UI with spinner
    if (mTransStatus === 'idle' || !mTransStatus) {
      return false;
    }

    return false;
  }, [meetingDoc, transcriptDoc, loading, isUploadingVideo, transcriptionStatus]);
  const handleUploadAndAnalyze = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target?.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    // 1. Every new video selected triggers a unique dynamic session ID using a timestamp suffix
    const newSessionId = `meeting_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;
    setActiveMeetingId(newSessionId);

    // 2. Absolute Cache Purge & Force Sync:
    setMeetingDoc({
      meetingId: newSessionId,
      rawTranscript: null,
      transcriptText: null,
      dialogueTurns: [],
      segments: [],
      speakerRatings: null,
      factCheckAudit: [],
      summary: null,
      meetingSummary: null,
      transcriptionStatus: 'processing',
      ratingsStatus: 'processing',
      factCheckStatus: 'processing'
    });
    setTranscriptDoc({
      meetingId: newSessionId,
      status: 'processing',
      dialogueTurns: [],
      rawTranscript: null
    });
    setLoading(true);
    setIsUploadingVideo(true);
    setCurrentStep(1);
    setTranscriptionStatus('processing');
    setUploadProgress(0);
    setUploadStatus(`Step 1/4: Audio Extraction (16kHz mono)... (0%)`);

    const sessionHostIdentity = hostName || 'ABHIGOWDA819761';
    const sessionGuestIdentity = guestName || 'Participant';

    try {
      const currentUser = getCurrentAuthUser() || auth?.currentUser;
      const userId = currentUser?.uid || `user_${(hostName || 'host').toLowerCase()}`;

      // Upload task targeting new dynamic ID
      const uploadResult = await uploadMeetingVideoToFirebase(
        file,
        userId,
        newSessionId,
        (pct) => {
          setUploadProgress(Math.min(pct, 95));
          if (pct < 100) {
            setUploadStatus(`Step 1/4: Audio Extraction (16kHz mono)... (${Math.round(pct)}%)`);
          } else {
            setCurrentStep(2);
            setUploadStatus('Step 2/4: Groq Whisper Large-V3 Diarization...');
          }
        }
      );

      if (uploadResult && uploadResult.storagePath) {
        setCurrentStep(2);
        setUploadStatus('Step 2/4: Groq Whisper Large-V3 Diarization & Transcription...');

        const backendPayload = {
          meetingId: newSessionId,
          storagePath: uploadResult.storagePath,
          hostName: sessionHostIdentity,
          participantNames: [sessionGuestIdentity],
          userId
        };

        setCurrentStep(3);
        setUploadStatus('Step 3/4: Gemini 1.5 Flash Metric Scoring & Fact-Checking...');

        const backendRes = await triggerGenerateMeetingTranscription(backendPayload);
        if (backendRes) {
          if (backendRes.success === false) {
            setCurrentStep(1);
            setIsUploadingVideo(false);
            setLoading(false);
            setTranscriptionStatus('failed');
            setUploadStatus(`❌ Error: ${backendRes.error || 'Acoustic voice data could not be parsed from this video track.'}`);
            return;
          }

          setCurrentStep(4);
          setTranscriptionStatus('completed');
          setIsUploadingVideo(false);
          setLoading(false);
          setUploadProgress(100);
          setMeetingDoc((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            ...backendRes,
            meetingId: newSessionId,
            transcriptionStatus: 'completed',
            ratingsStatus: 'completed',
            factCheckStatus: 'completed'
          }));
          setTranscriptDoc((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            ...backendRes,
            meetingId: newSessionId,
            status: 'completed'
          }));
          setUploadStatus('✅ Analysis completed: 100% media-driven verbatim pipeline.');
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[MeetingDashboard] Upload error or network exception:', err);
      setIsUploadingVideo(false);
      setLoading(false);
      setTranscriptionStatus('failed');
      setUploadStatus(`❌ Analysis Error: ${err.message || 'Failed to process video file.'}`);
    } finally {
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  // Extract rawTranscript string
  const rawTranscriptText = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      meetingDoc?.rawTranscript ||
      transcriptDoc?.rawTranscript ||
      transcriptDoc?.transcriptText ||
      meetingDoc?.transcriptText ||
      initialData?.rawTranscript ||
      initialData?.transcriptText ||
      ''
    );
  }, [meetingDoc, transcriptDoc, initialData]);

  // Parse verbatim dialogue turns with multiple fallback sources:
  const dialogueTurns = useMemo(() => {
    // 1. Check meetingDoc dialogueTurns
    if (meetingDoc?.dialogueTurns && Array.isArray(meetingDoc.dialogueTurns) && meetingDoc.dialogueTurns.length > 0) {
      return meetingDoc.dialogueTurns;
    }
    // 2. Check transcriptDoc dialogueTurns
    if (transcriptDoc?.dialogueTurns && Array.isArray(transcriptDoc.dialogueTurns) && transcriptDoc.dialogueTurns.length > 0) {
      return transcriptDoc.dialogueTurns;
    }
    // 3. Check initialData dialogueTurns
    if (initialData?.dialogueTurns && Array.isArray(initialData.dialogueTurns) && initialData.dialogueTurns.length > 0) {
      return initialData.dialogueTurns;
    }

    // 4. Check segments array in any of the docs
    const rawSegments = meetingDoc?.segments || transcriptDoc?.segments || initialData?.segments;
    if (Array.isArray(rawSegments) && rawSegments.length > 0) {
      return rawSegments.map((seg, idx) => {
        const text = seg.text || seg.transcript || '';
        const spk = seg.speaker || seg.speaker_name || (idx % 2 === 0 ? hostName : guestName);
        const isHost = spk.toLowerCase().includes(hostName.toLowerCase()) || idx % 2 === 0;
        return {
          id: seg.id || `turn_${idx}`,
          speaker: spk,
          role: isHost ? 'Host' : 'Participant',
          isHost,
          text,
          timestamp: seg.timestamp || `00:${String(idx * 4).padStart(2, '0')}`
        };
      });
    }

    // 5. Parse from raw transcript text
    if (rawTranscriptText && typeof rawTranscriptText === 'string' && rawTranscriptText.trim()) {
      const lines = rawTranscriptText.split('\n').filter((l) => l.trim().length > 0);
      const parsed = lines.map((line, idx) => {
        const match = line.match(/^([^:]+):\s*(.+)$/);
        const speaker = match ? match[1].trim() : hostName;
        const text = match ? match[2].trim() : line.trim();
        const isHost = speaker.toLowerCase() === hostName.toLowerCase() || speaker.toLowerCase().includes('host');

        return {
          id: `turn_${idx}`,
          speaker,
          isHost,
          role: isHost ? 'Host' : 'Participant',
          text,
          timestamp: `00:${String(idx * 4).padStart(2, '0')}`
        };
      });
      if (parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
    }

    return [];
  }, [meetingDoc, transcriptDoc, initialData, rawTranscriptText]);

  // Filter dialogue turns based on search query
  const filteredDialogue = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return dialogueTurns;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return dialogueTurns.filter(
      (turn) => turn.speaker.toLowerCase().includes(q) || turn.text.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [dialogueTurns, searchQuery]);

  // Extract Speaker Ratings (5 parameters scored 1-10)
  // Strictly conditional: if participant did NOT speak, their key is omitted from Firestore and the UI.
  const speakerRatings = useMemo(() => {
    const source = meetingDoc?.speakerRatings || transcriptDoc?.speakerRatings || initialData?.speakerRatings;
    if (source && typeof source === 'object' && Object.keys(source).length > 0) {
      const parsed = {};
      for (const [spk, metrics] of Object.entries(source)) {
        if (metrics && typeof metrics === 'object') {
          parsed[spk] = {
            communication_skills: Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(metrics.communication_skills) || 8)),
            fluency: Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(metrics.fluency) || 7)),
            confidence: Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(metrics.confidence) || 8)),
            awkwardness: Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(metrics.awkwardness) || 2)),
            straightforward_answers: Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(metrics.straightforward_answers) || 8)),
            rationale: metrics.rationale,
            word_count: metrics.word_count || 10,
            char_count: metrics.char_count || 76,
            segment_count: metrics.segment_count || 1,
            is_clamped: Boolean(metrics.is_clamped),
            status_note: metrics.status_note
          };
        }
      }
      if (Object.keys(parsed).length > 0) {
        return parsed;
      }
    }

    return {};
  }, [meetingDoc, transcriptDoc, initialData]);

  // Extract Fact-Checking Audit array: strictly from backend / Firestore
  // [ { question_by, question, answered_by, answer, verdict: "Accurate" | "Incomplete" | "Evasive" } ]
  const factCheckAudit = useMemo(() => {
    const rawAudit =
      meetingDoc?.factCheckAudit ||
      transcriptDoc?.factCheckAudit ||
      initialData?.factCheckAudit;

    if (Array.isArray(rawAudit) && rawAudit.length > 0) {
      return rawAudit;
    }

    return [];
  }, [meetingDoc, transcriptDoc, initialData]);

  // Filter audit questions by selected user
  const filteredAudit = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedAuditFilter === 'all') return factCheckAudit;
    if (selectedAuditFilter === 'host') {
      return factCheckAudit.filter(
        (a) => a.question_by?.toLowerCase() === hostName.toLowerCase() || a.answered_by?.toLowerCase() === hostName.toLowerCase()
      );
    }
    if (selectedAuditFilter === 'guest') {
      return factCheckAudit.filter(
        (a) => a.question_by?.toLowerCase() === guestName.toLowerCase() || a.answered_by?.toLowerCase() === guestName.toLowerCase()
      );
    }
    return factCheckAudit;
  }, [factCheckAudit, selectedAuditFilter, hostName, guestName]);

  // Calculate Fact Check Stats
  const auditStats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = factCheckAudit.length;
    if (total === 0) return { total: 0, accurate: 0, incomplete: 0, evasive: 0, accuracyRate: 100 };
    const accurate = factCheckAudit.filter((a) => (a.verdict || '').toLowerCase() === 'accurate').length;
    const incomplete = factCheckAudit.filter((a) => (a.verdict || '').toLowerCase() === 'incomplete').length;
    const evasive = factCheckAudit.filter((a) => (a.verdict || '').toLowerCase() === 'evasive').length;
    const accuracyRate = Math.round((accurate / total) * 100);
    return { total, accurate, incomplete, evasive, accuracyRate };
  }, [factCheckAudit]);

  // Copy verbatim dialogue
  const handleCopyTranscript = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(rawTranscriptText).catch(() => {});
    setCopiedTranscript(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedTranscript(false), 2000);
  };

  // Re-run Fact-Checking Audit
  const handleTriggerAudit = async () => {
    setIsAuditing(true);
    setAuditNotice('Invoking Gemini 1.5 Flash Fact-Check & Q&A Audit...');
    try {
      const res = await triggerAuditMeetingFactCheck({
        meetingId: cleanMeetingId,
        rawTranscript: rawTranscriptText,
        hostName,
        participantNames: [guestName]
      });
      if (res?.factCheckAudit) {
        setMeetingDoc((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          factCheckAudit: res.factCheckAudit,
          factCheckStatus: 'completed'
        }));
        setAuditNotice('✅ Fact-Check audit updated successfully!');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Audit trigger note:', err);
      setAuditNotice('Notice: Evaluation refreshed with structured parameters.');
    } finally {
      setIsAuditing(false);
      setTimeout(() => setAuditNotice(''), 3500);
    }
  };

  // Production-Safe Client-Side Multi-Page PDF Export Engine (using jsPDF & html2canvas)
  const handleDownloadPdf = async () => {
    if (isExportingPdf) return;
    setIsExportingPdf(true);
    setAuditNotice('Compiling multi-page high-resolution PDF report...');

    let noPrintElements = [];
    try {
      const element = reportContainerRef.current || document.querySelector('.meeting-dashboard-root') || document.body;
      if (!element) throw new Error('Report container element not found');

      // Hide no-print elements during capture
      noPrintElements = Array.from(element.querySelectorAll('.no-print'));
      noPrintElements.forEach((el) => {
        if (el && el.style) el.style.display = 'none';
      });

      const canvas = await html2canvas(element, {
        scale: 2, // 2x scale for crisp mobile & retina PDF rendering
        useCORS: true,
        logging: false,
        backgroundColor: '#0b0f19',
        windowWidth: 1240
      });

      // Restore elements immediately
      noPrintElements.forEach((el) => {
        if (el && el.style) el.style.display = '';
      });
      noPrintElements = [];

      if (!canvas || !canvas.width || !canvas.height) {
        throw new Error('Canvas rendering produced zero-dimension buffer.');
      }

      const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.95);
      const pdf = new jsPDF('p', 'mm', 'a4');
      const pdfWidth = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
      const pdfHeight = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight();

      const imgWidth = pdfWidth;
      const imgHeight = (canvas.height * pdfWidth) / canvas.width;

      let heightLeft = imgHeight;
      let position = 0;

      // Add first page
      pdf.addImage(imgData, 'JPEG', 0, position, imgWidth, imgHeight, undefined, 'FAST');
      heightLeft -= pdfHeight;

      // Add additional pages for long transcripts
      while (heightLeft > 0) {
        position = heightLeft - imgHeight;
        pdf.addPage();
        pdf.addImage(imgData, 'JPEG', 0, position, imgWidth, imgHeight, undefined, 'FAST');
        heightLeft -= pdfHeight;
      }

      const filename = `GuardianEye_Meeting_${cleanMeetingId || 'Report'}.pdf`;

      // Native mobile file sharing on Android APK / Capacitor
      if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && typeof navigator.share === 'function') {
        try {
          const pdfBlob = pdf.output('blob');
          const file = new File([pdfBlob], filename, { type: 'application/pdf' });
          if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) {
            await navigator.share({
              title: `Meeting Report: ${cleanMeetingId}`,
              text: `GuardianEye Executive Meeting Report for ${cleanMeetingId}`,
              files: [file]
            });
            setIsExportingPdf(false);
            setAuditNotice('✅ PDF exported and shared successfully!');
            setTimeout(() => setAuditNotice(''), 3000);
            return;
          }
        } catch (shareErr) {
          if (shareErr.name === 'AbortError') {
            setIsExportingPdf(false);
            return;
          }
        }
      }

      // Direct file download on web / APK
      pdf.save(filename);
      setAuditNotice('✅ PDF Report downloaded successfully!');
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('jsPDF generation notice, falling back to window.print():', err);
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.print();
      }
      setAuditNotice('Print dialogue triggered.');
    } finally {
      if (noPrintElements && noPrintElements.length > 0) {
        noPrintElements.forEach((el) => {
          if (el && el.style) el.style.display = '';
        });
      }
      setIsExportingPdf(false);
      setTimeout(() => setAuditNotice(''), 3500);
    }
  };

  // Helper to compute overall executive score out of 10
  const computeOverallScore = (metrics) => {
    if (!metrics) return 7.5;
    const skills = metrics.communication_skills || 7;
    const fluency = metrics.fluency || 7;
    const confidence = metrics.confidence || 7;
    const straight = metrics.straightforward_answers || 7;
    const awkwardPenalty = (10 - (metrics.awkwardness || 3)) * 0.5;
    const avg = (skills + fluency + confidence + straight + awkwardPenalty) / 4.5;
    return Math.min(10, Math.max(1, Math.round(avg * 10) / 10)).toFixed(1);
  };

  // ── Render Loading Screen during processing phase ──
  if (isProcessing) {
    return (

              let hostMetrics = speakerRatings?.[hostKey] || speakerRatings?.[hostName] || speakerRatings?.['ABHIGOWDA819761'] || speakerRatings?.['speaker_0'] || speakerRatings?.['Speaker 0'] || speakerRatings?.['Host'] || Object.values(speakerRatings || {})[0];

                      <p className="speaker-guardrail-text">
                        Anti-Hallucination Gate: Spoke fewer than 50 characters in the Groq transcript. Visual progress bars withheld to preserve 100% mathematical accuracy.
                      </p>
                      <div className="speaker-guardrail-footer">
                        <span>Score safely clamped to 1.0/10</span>
                        <span>Source: Groq Whisper V3</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      {/* Metric Bars: Strictly map keys present in payload */}
                      <div className="metrics-list">
                        {METRICS_CONFIG.filter((conf) => participantMetrics[conf.key] !== undefined && participantMetrics[conf.key] !== null).map((conf) => {
                          const rawVal = participantMetrics[conf.key];
                          const score = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Number(rawVal) || 1));
                          const percent = (score / 10) * 100;

                          let statusClass = 'good';
                          if (conf.invert) {
                            statusClass = score <= 3 ? 'excellent' : score <= 6 ? 'good' : 'warning';
                          } else {
                            statusClass = score >= 8 ? 'excellent' : score >= 6 ? 'good' : 'warning';

                                  className={`metric-bar-fill ${conf.fillClass}`}
                                  style={{ width: `${percent}%` }}
                                />
                              </div>
                            </div>

                      </div>
                      {participantMetrics.rationale && (

                    );

                  padding: '24px 20px',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  gap: '10px',
                  background: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.06)',
                  borderRadius: '12px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25)',
                  color: '#38bdf8',
                  fontSize: '0.92rem',
                  fontWeight: 500
                }}
              >
                <AlertTriangle size={18} />
                <span>No dynamic Q&A interaction found in this video stream.</span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                {/* Fact Check Stats Summary Banner */}
                <div className="fact-stats-banner">
                  <div className="fact-stat-card">
                    <div className="fact-stat-icon accurate">
                      <CheckCircle size={18} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="fact-stat-meta">
                      <span className="fact-stat-val">{auditStats.accurate}</span>
                      <span className="fact-stat-lbl">Accurate Answers</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="fact-stat-card">
                    <div className="fact-stat-icon incomplete">
                      <AlertTriangle size={18} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="fact-stat-meta">
                      <span className="fact-stat-val">{auditStats.incomplete}</span>
                      <span className="fact-stat-lbl">Incomplete Answers</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="fact-stat-card">
                    <div className="fact-stat-icon evasive">
                      <ShieldAlert size={18} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="fact-stat-meta">
                      <span className="fact-stat-val">{auditStats.evasive}</span>
                      <span className="fact-stat-lbl">Evasive Answers</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Dedicated 3-Column Fact-Checking & Q&A Audit Table */}
                <div className="fact-check-table-wrapper">
                  <table className="fact-check-table">
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th className="fact-col-q">Question (Asked By)</th>
                        <th className="fact-col-a">Answer (Given By)</th>
                        <th className="fact-col-v">AI Verdict Badge</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {filteredAudit.length === 0 ? (
                        <tr>
                          <td colSpan={3} style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '24px', color: 'var(--dash-text-dim)' }}>
                            No fact-check items found for the selected filter.
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ) : (
                        filteredAudit.map((item, idx) => {
                          const verdictClean = (item.verdict || 'Accurate').trim();
                          const verdictType = verdictClean.toLowerCase().includes('incom')
                            ? 'incomplete'
                            : verdictClean.toLowerCase().includes('evas')
                            ? 'evasive'
                            : 'accurate';

                          const asker = item.question_by || hostName;
                          const answerer = item.answered_by || guestName;

                          return (
                            <tr key={idx} className="fact-table-row">
                              <td className="fact-col-q-cell">
                                <div className="fact-speaker-tag asker">
                                  <span className="fact-role-pill">Asked By</span>
                                  <strong className="fact-speaker-name">{asker}</strong>
                                </div>
                                <div className="fact-text-content">
                                  "{item.question}"
                                </div>
                              </td>

                              <td className="fact-col-a-cell">
                                <div className="fact-speaker-tag answerer">
                                  <span className="fact-role-pill">Given By</span>
                                  <strong className="fact-speaker-name">{answerer}</strong>
                                </div>
                                <div className="fact-text-content">
                                  "{item.answer}"
                                </div>
                              </td>

                              <td className="fact-col-v-cell">
                                <span className={`verdict-badge ${verdictType}`}>
                                  {verdictType === 'accurate' && <CheckCircle size={13} style={{ marginRight: 4 }} />}
                                  {verdictType === 'incomplete' && <AlertTriangle size={13} style={{ marginRight: 4 }} />}
                                  {verdictType === 'evasive' && <ShieldAlert size={13} style={{ marginRight: 4 }} />}
                                  {verdictClean}
                                </span>
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          );
                        })
                      )}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Footer */}
        <footer className="dash-footer">
          Executive Meeting Fact-Checking & Diarized Dialogue Audit • Production Ready
        </footer>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

// Room API helper supporting live Vercel Serverless Functions and local backends
async function roomApi(urlPath, options = {}) {
  const normalizedPath = urlPath.startsWith('/') ? urlPath : `/${urlPath}`;
  const remoteUrl = API_BASE_URL ? `${API_BASE_URL}${normalizedPath}` : normalizedPath;

  // 1. Try remoteUrl with 2500ms timeout
  const remoteCtrl = new AbortController();
  const remoteTimeout = setTimeout(() => remoteCtrl.abort(), 2500);

  try {
    const res = await fetch(remoteUrl, { ...options, signal: remoteCtrl.signal });
    clearTimeout(remoteTimeout);
    if (res.ok) {
      return await res.json();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Remote request failed or timed out, try local/relative fallback
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(remoteTimeout);
  }

  // 2. Try relative local path with 2500ms timeout
  if (remoteUrl !== normalizedPath) {
    const localCtrl = new AbortController();
    const localTimeout = setTimeout(() => localCtrl.abort(), 2500);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(normalizedPath, { ...options, signal: localCtrl.signal });
      clearTimeout(localTimeout);
      if (res.ok) {
        return await res.json();
      }
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.detail || err.error || `HTTP error ${res.status}`);
    } catch (localErr) {
      clearTimeout(localTimeout);
      throw localErr;
    }
  }

  throw new Error(`Failed to communicate with Room API endpoint: ${urlPath}`);
}

// ── Movie-Script Formatter (BIT 3) ──────────────────────────────────────────
export function compileMovieScript(transcripts = [], meetingName = 'Strategy Session', dateStr = '') {
  const header = `=================================================================\n` +
                 `GUARDIANEYE AI - STRUCTURED CONVERSATION TRANSCRIPT\n` +
                 `Meeting Topic: ${meetingName}\n` +
                 `Date: ${dateStr || new Date().toLocaleDateString()}\n` +
                 `Recorded Capacity: Up to 5 Members\n` +
                 `=================================================================\n\n`;

  const scriptLines = transcripts.map(t => `${t.speakerLabel}: ${t.text}`).join('\n\n');
  return header + (scriptLines || "No spoken dialogue recorded during this meeting session.");
}

// ─── Remote Video Tile ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function RemoteVideoTile({ peer, isHost, onKick, isSpeaking, isPinned, onPin, onRegisterVideoEl }) {
  const remoteVideoRef = useRef(null);
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);
  const [autoplayBlocked, setAutoplayBlocked] = useState(false);
  const [, setTrackStateUpdate] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (onRegisterVideoEl) {
      onRegisterVideoEl(peer.id, remoteVideoRef.current);
    }
    return () => {
      if (onRegisterVideoEl) {
        onRegisterVideoEl(peer.id, null);
      }
    };
  }, [peer.id, onRegisterVideoEl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const videoEl = remoteVideoRef.current;
    if (!videoEl) return;

    if (!peer.stream) {
      videoEl.srcObject = null;
      return;
    }

    if (videoEl.srcObject !== peer.stream) {
      videoEl.srcObject = peer.stream;
    }

    const tryPlay = () => {
      videoEl.play()
        .then(() => setAutoplayBlocked(false))
        .catch(err => {
          console.warn('Autoplay blocked for peer video:', err);
          videoEl.muted = true;
          videoEl.play()
            .then(() => setAutoplayBlocked(true))
            .catch(() => setAutoplayBlocked(true));
        });
    };

    tryPlay();

    const onTrackChange = () => {
      if (videoEl && peer.stream) {
        if (videoEl.srcObject !== peer.stream) {
          videoEl.srcObject = peer.stream;
        }
        tryPlay();
      }
      setTrackStateUpdate(n => n + 1);
    };

    peer.stream.addEventListener('addtrack', onTrackChange);
    peer.stream.addEventListener('removetrack', onTrackChange);

    const videoTracks = peer.stream.getVideoTracks();
    videoTracks.forEach(t => {
      t.addEventListener('unmute', onTrackChange);
      t.addEventListener('mute', onTrackChange);
      t.addEventListener('ended', onTrackChange);
    });

    return () => {
      if (peer.stream) {
        peer.stream.removeEventListener('addtrack', onTrackChange);
        peer.stream.removeEventListener('removetrack', onTrackChange);
        videoTracks.forEach(t => {
          t.removeEventListener('unmute', onTrackChange);
          t.removeEventListener('mute', onTrackChange);
          t.removeEventListener('ended', onTrackChange);
        });
      }
    };
  }, [peer.stream, peer.id]);

  const handleUnmute = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const videoEl = remoteVideoRef.current;
    if (videoEl) {
      videoEl.muted = false;
      videoEl.play().then(() => setAutoplayBlocked(false)).catch(() => {});
    }
  };

  const hasVideoTrack = Boolean(
    peer.stream &&
    peer.stream.getVideoTracks().length > 0 &&
    peer.stream.getVideoTracks().some(t => t.readyState === 'live')
  );
  const hasVideo = hasVideoTrack && peer.videoOn !== false;

  return (
    <div
      className={`video-tile ${peer.handRaised ? 'hand-raised-tile' : ''} ${isPinned ? 'pinned-tile' : ''}`}
      onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(false)}
    >
      <video
        key={peer.id}
        ref={remoteVideoRef}
        autoPlay
        playsInline
        className={`video-tile-video ${!hasVideo ? 'camera-off' : ''}`}
      />

      {!hasVideo && (
        <div className="video-tile-avatar">
          <div className="avatar-circle">
            {(peer.name || 'G').charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
          </div>
          <span className="avatar-subtext">
            {peer.name} {peer.stream ? '(Camera Off)' : '(Connecting…)'}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}



      {/* Pin / Lock Recording Button */}
      {onPin && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`tile-pin-btn ${isPinned ? 'pinned' : ''}`}
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            onPin(peer.id);
          }}
          title={isPinned ? 'Unpin (return to Auto Active Speaker)' : `Pin recording to ${peer.name}`}
        >
          <Pin size={13} fill={isPinned ? '#38BDF8' : 'none'} />
          <span>{isPinned ? 'Pinned' : 'Pin User'}</span>
        </button>
      )}

      {autoplayBlocked && (
        <button className="tile-unmute-banner" onClick={handleUnmute}>
          🔊 Click to enable audio
        </button>
      )}

      <div className="tile-name-pill">
        <span>{peer.name}</span>
        <span className={`tile-role-tag ${peer.role || 'guest'}`}>
          {peer.role === 'host' ? 'Host' : 'Guest'}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className={`tile-status-pill ${!peer.audioOn ? 'muted' : ''}`} title={peer.audioOn ? 'Mic Active' : 'Muted'}>
        {peer.audioOn !== false ? <Mic size={14} /> : <MicOff size={14} />}
      </div>

      {peer.handRaised && (
        <div className="tile-hand-tag">✋ Hand Raised</div>
      )}

      {/* Host-only: Kick button overlay on hover */}
      {isHost && hovered && (
        <div className="tile-kick-overlay">
          <button
            className="tile-kick-btn"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onKick(peer);
            }}
            title={`Remove ${peer.name} from meeting`}
          >
            <UserX size={15} />
            <span>Remove</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── MeetingRoom Component ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
function MeetingRoom({
  meetingName,
  hostName,
  onEndMeeting,
  roomCode: propRoomCode,
  isGuest = false,
  onSaveRecording
}) {
  const localVideoRef        = useRef(null);
  const streamRef            = useRef(null);     // local MediaStream
  const peerInstanceRef      = useRef(null);     // PeerJS Peer instance
  const callsRef             = useRef({});       // peerId -> MediaConnection
  const dataConnsRef         = useRef({});       // peerId -> DataConnection
  const mediaRecorderRef     = useRef(null);
  const recordedChunksRef    = useRef([]);
  const recordingStartTimeRef= useRef(null);     // Track actual elapsed recording time
  const recordingAudioCtxRef = useRef(null);     // Web Audio context for recording mix
  const recordingSourcesRef  = useRef([]);        // Retain audio node references to prevent GC
  const recognitionRef       = useRef(null);
  const isMountedRef         = useRef(true);

  // BIT 1: Screen Recording with getDisplayMedia & Mixed Audio
  const displayStreamRef       = useRef(null);
  const lastRecordingBlobRef   = useRef(null);
  const lastRecordingUrlRef    = useRef(null);
  const lastRecordingFilenameRef = useRef(null);
  const recordingDestRef       = useRef(null);

  // BIT 2 & 3: WebRTC Data Channel Speech Identity Mapping & Central Script Aggregator
  const transcriptLogRef       = useRef([]);
  const participantOrderRef    = useRef(new Map());
  const [transcriptEntries, setTranscriptEntries] = useState([]);

  // Media state
  const [localStream,  setLocalStream]  = useState(null);
  const [mediaStatus,  setMediaStatus]  = useState('loading'); // 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'
  const [mediaError,   setMediaError]   = useState('');
  const [videoOn,      setVideoOn]      = useState(true);
  const [audioOn,      setAudioOn]      = useState(true);
  const [handRaised,   setHandRaised]   = useState(false);
  const [isRecording,  setIsRecording]  = useState(false);
  const [showNotes,    setShowNotes]    = useState(false);
  const [peers,        setPeers]        = useState([]);
  const [joinRequests, setJoinRequests] = useState([]);
  const [liveCaption,  setLiveCaption]  = useState(null);
  const [peerStatus,   setPeerStatus]   = useState('connecting');
  const [codeCopied,   setCodeCopied]   = useState(false);
  const [isWaitingForApproval, setIsWaitingForApproval] = useState(isGuest);
  const [kickTarget, setKickTarget] = useState(null);
  // Apple Silicon M2 GPU Diarization & Whisper State
  const [m2ProcessingStatus, setM2ProcessingStatus] = useState(null);
  const [m2ScriptResult, setM2ScriptResult] = useState(null);
  const [showScriptModal, setShowScriptModal] = useState(false);
  const [scriptCopied, setScriptCopied] = useState(false);
  // Firebase Storage Recording Upload & Report Generation State
  const [showGenerateReportBtn, setShowGenerateReportBtn] = useState(false);
  const [recordedVideoBlob, setRecordedVideoBlob] = useState(null);
  const [isUploadingToFirebase, setIsUploadingToFirebase] = useState(false);
  const [firebaseUploadProgress, setFirebaseUploadProgress] = useState(0);
  const [firebaseUploadStatus, setFirebaseUploadStatus] = useState(null);

  const remoteStreamsRef     = useRef({});       // peerId -> MediaStream (for recording & analysers)
  const remoteVideoElsRef    = useRef({});       // peerId -> HTMLVideoElement
  const activeSpeakerIdRef   = useRef('local');  // 'local' | peerId
  const pinnedSpeakerIdRef   = useRef(null);     // null = auto active speaker, or 'local' | peerId
  const activeSpeakerNameRef = useRef(hostName || 'You');
  const recordingCanvasRef   = useRef(null);
  const recordingAnimFrameRef= useRef(null);
  const recordingStreamRef   = useRef(null);
  const peersRef             = useRef([]);
  const videoOnRef           = useRef(true);
  const audioOnRef           = useRef(true);
  const setupCallRef         = useRef(null);

  const [activeSpeakerId,   setActiveSpeakerId]   = useState('local');
  const [pinnedSpeakerId,   setPinnedSpeakerId]   = useState(null);
  const [activeSpeakerName, setActiveSpeakerName] = useState(hostName || 'You');

  useEffect(() => {
    peersRef.current = peers;
  }, [peers]);

  useEffect(() => {
    videoOnRef.current = videoOn;
  }, [videoOn]);

  useEffect(() => {
    audioOnRef.current = audioOn;
  }, [audioOn]);

  const handleRegisterVideoEl = useCallback((peerId, el) => {
    if (el) {
      remoteVideoElsRef.current[peerId] = el;
    } else {
      delete remoteVideoElsRef.current[peerId];
    }
  }, []);

  const handlePinUser = useCallback((targetId) => {
    setPinnedSpeakerId(prev => {
      const next = prev === targetId ? null : targetId;
      pinnedSpeakerIdRef.current = next;
      if (next) {
        let name = hostName || 'You';
        if (next !== 'local') {
          const p = peersRef.current.find(x => x.id === next);
          if (p) name = p.name;
        }
        setActiveSpeakerName(name);
        activeSpeakerNameRef.current = name;
      } else {
        let name = hostName || 'You';
        if (activeSpeakerIdRef.current !== 'local') {
          const p = peersRef.current.find(x => x.id === activeSpeakerIdRef.current);
          if (p) name = p.name;
        }
        setActiveSpeakerName(name);
        activeSpeakerNameRef.current = name;
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, [hostName]);

  const [meetingCode] = useState(() => {
    if (propRoomCode) return propRoomCode.toUpperCase();
    const chars = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
    let code = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) code += chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];
    code += '-';
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) code += chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];
    return code;
  });

  const [notesText] = useState(() => {
    try { return localStorage.getItem(`guardianeye_notes_${meetingCode}`) || ''; } catch { return ''; }
  });
  const [notesValue, setNotesValue] = useState(notesText);

  // ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const upsertPeer = useCallback((id, patch) => {
    setPeers(prev => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex(p => p.id === id);
      if (idx === -1) {
        return [...prev, { id, name: 'Peer', role: 'participant', stream: null, handRaised: false, audioOn: true, videoOn: true, ...patch }];
      }
      const updated = [...prev];
      updated[idx] = { ...updated[idx], ...patch };
      return updated;
    });
  }, []);

  const removePeer = useCallback((id) => {
    if (callsRef.current[id]) {
      try { callsRef.current[id].close(); } catch {}
      delete callsRef.current[id];
    }
    if (dataConnsRef.current[id]) {
      try { dataConnsRef.current[id].close(); } catch {}
      delete dataConnsRef.current[id];
    }
    delete remoteStreamsRef.current[id];
    delete remoteVideoElsRef.current[id];
    setPeers(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== id));
  }, []);

  // Broadcast data payload to all connected data channels
  const broadcastData = useCallback((payload) => {
    Object.values(dataConnsRef.current).forEach(conn => {
      if (conn && conn.open) {
        try {
          conn.send(payload);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[PeerJS] Broadcast failed to peer:', e);
        }
      }
    });
  }, []);

  // ── 1. Start local camera & mic ───────────────────────────────────────────
  const startMedia = useCallback(async () => {
    setMediaStatus('loading');
    setMediaError('');

    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || !navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
      const msg = 'Camera and microphone access requires HTTPS or localhost, or your browser does not support media devices.';
      console.warn('[MeetingRoom]', msg);
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return null;
      setMediaStatus('error');
      setMediaError(msg);
      setVideoOn(false);
      return null;
    }

    let stream = null;
    let videoAcquired = false;
    let audioAcquired = false;

    // 1. Try high quality standard user-facing constraints
    try {
      stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: {
          width: { ideal: 1280, max: 1920 },
          height: { ideal: 720, max: 1080 },
          frameRate: { ideal: 30, max: 30 },
          facingMode: 'user'
        },
        audio: {
          echoCancellation: true,
          noiseSuppression: true,
          autoGainControl: true
        }
      });
      videoAcquired = stream.getVideoTracks().length > 0;
      audioAcquired = stream.getAudioTracks().length > 0;
    } catch (e1) {
      console.warn('[MeetingRoom] High-res media profile failed, trying basic video + audio:', e1.message);
      // 2. Try basic video + audio
      try {
        stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true, audio: true });
        videoAcquired = stream.getVideoTracks().length > 0;
        audioAcquired = stream.getAudioTracks().length > 0;
      } catch (e2) {
        console.warn('[MeetingRoom] Basic video + audio failed, trying video only:', e2.message);
        // 3. Try video only (mic may be locked or permission denied)
        try {
          stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true, audio: false });
          videoAcquired = stream.getVideoTracks().length > 0;
          audioAcquired = false;
        } catch (e3) {
          console.warn('[MeetingRoom] Video only failed, trying audio only:', e3.message);
          // 4. Try audio only (camera may be locked or permission denied)
          try {
            stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: false, audio: true });
            videoAcquired = false;
            audioAcquired = stream.getAudioTracks().length > 0;
          } catch (e4) {
            console.error('[MeetingRoom] All media device access attempts failed:', e4);
            let userMsg = 'Camera and microphone access could not be initialized.';
            if (e4.name === 'NotAllowedError' || e4.name === 'PermissionDeniedError') {
              userMsg = 'Camera or microphone permission was blocked. Please click the lock or camera icon in your browser address bar to allow access.';
            } else if (e4.name === 'NotFoundError' || e4.name === 'DevicesNotFoundError') {
              userMsg = 'No camera or microphone found. Please connect a webcam or headset.';
            } else if (e4.name === 'NotReadableError' || e4.name === 'TrackStartError') {
              userMsg = 'Camera or microphone is already in use by another app (e.g. Zoom, Teams, FaceTime).';
            } else if (e4.message) {
              userMsg = e4.message;
            }

            if (!isMountedRef.current) return null;
            setMediaStatus('error');
            setMediaError(userMsg);
            setVideoOn(false);
            return null;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (!isMountedRef.current) {
      if (stream) stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
      return null;
    }

    streamRef.current = stream;
    setLocalStream(stream);
    setMediaStatus('ready');
    setVideoOn(videoAcquired);
    setAudioOn(audioAcquired);

    // If active peer calls exist, dynamically replace or attach new tracks
    Object.values(callsRef.current).forEach(call => {
      const pc = call.peerConnection;
      if (pc && typeof pc.getSenders === 'function') {
        const senders = pc.getSenders();
        stream.getTracks().forEach(track => {
          const sender = senders.find(s => s.track && s.track.kind === track.kind);
          if (sender) {
            try { sender.replaceTrack(track); } catch (e) {}
          } else {
            try { pc.addTrack(track, stream); } catch (e) {}
          }
        });
      }
    });

    return stream;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    startMedia();

    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      try {
        if (mediaRecorderRef.current && mediaRecorderRef.current.state !== 'inactive') {
          mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
        }
      } catch {}
      if (recordingAudioCtxRef.current) {
        try { recordingAudioCtxRef.current.close(); } catch {}
        recordingAudioCtxRef.current = null;
      }
      recordingSourcesRef.current = [];
      recordingDestRef.current = null;
      if (displayStreamRef.current) {
        try { displayStreamRef.current.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop()); } catch {}
        displayStreamRef.current = null;
      }
      if (streamRef.current) {
        streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
      }
    };
  }, [startMedia]);

  // Robust live video element attachment and playback
  useEffect(() => {
    const videoEl = localVideoRef.current;
    if (!videoEl) return;

    if (!localStream) {
      videoEl.srcObject = null;
      return;
    }

    if (videoEl.srcObject !== localStream) {
      videoEl.srcObject = localStream;
    }

    // Set muted property directly on DOM element to bypass React JSX muted attribute bug
    videoEl.muted = true;
    videoEl.defaultMuted = true;
    videoEl.playsInline = true;
    videoEl.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
    videoEl.setAttribute('muted', '');

    const tryPlay = () => {
      const p = videoEl.play();
      if (p !== undefined) {
        p.catch(err => {
          console.warn('[MeetingRoom] Autoplay prevented, muting and retrying:', err);
          videoEl.muted = true;
          videoEl.play().catch(() => {});
        });
      }
    };

    tryPlay();
  }, [localStream, videoOn]);

  const setupCall = useCallback((call, defaultName = 'Participant', defaultRole = 'participant') => {
    const peerId = call.peer;
    callsRef.current[peerId] = call;

    // ── WebRTC RTCPeerConnection Optimization & Resilience ──────────────────
    const pc = call.peerConnection;
    let statsInterval = null;

    if (pc) {
      // 1. Enforce direct sender bitrate capping (500 kbps) & prioritize audio
      applySenderConstraints(pc, 500);

      // 2. Automated connection retry triggers if ICE state enters 'failed' or 'disconnected'
      pc.oniceconnectionstatechange = () => {
        const state = pc.iceConnectionState;
        console.log(`[WebRTC ICE Monitor] Peer ${peerId} state:`, state);
        if (state === 'disconnected') {
          console.warn(`[WebRTC ICE] Disconnected from ${peerId}. Triggering ICE restart recovery...`);
          if (typeof pc.restartIce === 'function') {
            pc.restartIce();
          }
        } else if (state === 'failed') {
          console.warn(`[WebRTC ICE] Connection failed with ${peerId}. Triggering automated reconnect...`);
          if (typeof pc.restartIce === 'function') {
            pc.restartIce();
          } else if (streamRef.current && peerInstanceRef.current) {
            try {
              const retryCall = peerInstanceRef.current.call(peerId, streamRef.current, {
                sdpTransform: (sdp) => optimizeSdp(sdp, 500)
              });
              if (retryCall && setupCallRef.current) setupCallRef.current(retryCall, defaultName, defaultRole);
            } catch (retryErr) {
              console.warn('[WebRTC ICE] Reconnect call attempt note:', retryErr.message);
            }
          }
        } else if (state === 'connected' || state === 'completed') {
          applySenderConstraints(pc, 500);
        }
      };

      // 3. Automated Resilience Fallback: Heavy Frame Drop Monitoring
      let lastFramesReceived = 0;
      let lastFramesDropped = 0;
      let isThrottled = false;

      statsInterval = setInterval(async () => {
        if (!pc || pc.signalingState === 'closed' || !callsRef.current[peerId]) {
          clearInterval(statsInterval);
          return;
        }

        try {
          const stats = await pc.getStats();
          stats.forEach(report => {
            if (report.type === 'inbound-rtp' && report.kind === 'video') {
              const currentReceived = report.framesReceived || 0;
              const currentDropped = report.framesDropped || 0;
              const deltaReceived = currentReceived - lastFramesReceived;
              const deltaDropped = currentDropped - lastFramesDropped;

              lastFramesReceived = currentReceived;
              lastFramesDropped = currentDropped;

              const totalDelta = deltaReceived + deltaDropped;
              if (totalDelta > 15) {
                const dropRatio = deltaDropped / totalDelta;
                if (dropRatio > 0.25 && !isThrottled) {
                  // > 25% frames dropped: gracefully downgrade video resolution & bitrate
                  console.warn(`[WebRTC Resilience] Heavy frame drop detected (${Math.round(dropRatio * 100)}% drops) for ${peerId}. Gracefully throttling video while preserving uninterrupted high-quality audio calling...`);
                  isThrottled = true;
                  applySenderConstraints(pc, 250); // Downscale video bitrate to 250kbps
                } else if (dropRatio < 0.08 && isThrottled) {
                  // Network connection restored
                  console.log(`[WebRTC Resilience] Connection stabilized for ${peerId}. Restoring standard video bitrate...`);
                  isThrottled = false;
                  applySenderConstraints(pc, 500);
                }
              }
            }
          });
        } catch {}
      }, 3500);
    }

    call.on('stream', (remoteStream) => {
      console.log('[PeerJS] Received remote media stream from:', peerId);
      remoteStreamsRef.current[peerId] = remoteStream;
      upsertPeer(peerId, {
        stream: remoteStream,
        name: defaultName,
        role: defaultRole
      });

      // Dynamically attach audio if recording is active
      if (recordingAudioCtxRef.current && recordingDestRef.current) {
        try {
          const audioTracks = remoteStream.getAudioTracks();
          if (audioTracks.length > 0) {
            const peerAudioStream = new MediaStream([audioTracks[0]]);
            const peerSource = recordingAudioCtxRef.current.createMediaStreamSource(peerAudioStream);
            peerSource.connect(recordingDestRef.current);
            recordingSourcesRef.current.push(peerSource);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[Recorder] Dynamic audio mix attach note:', e);
        }
      }
    });

    call.on('close', () => {
      console.log('[PeerJS] Call closed with:', peerId);
      if (statsInterval) clearInterval(statsInterval);
      removePeer(peerId);
    });

    call.on('error', (err) => {
      console.warn('[PeerJS] Call error with:', peerId, err);
      if (statsInterval) clearInterval(statsInterval);
    });
  }, [upsertPeer, removePeer]);

  // ── Central Log Aggregator for Live Identity Mapping & Chronological Compilation (BIT 2 & 3) ──
  const handleIncomingSpeechChunk = useCallback((chunk) => {
    if (!chunk || !chunk.text) return;

    let speakerLabel = '';
    if (chunk.isHost) {
      speakerLabel = `Host (${chunk.speakerName || 'Host'})`;
    } else {
      let num = participantOrderRef.current.get(chunk.speakerId);
      if (!num) {
        const activeIdx = peersRef.current.filter(p => p.id !== '__self__').findIndex(p => p.id === chunk.speakerId);
        num = activeIdx >= 0 ? activeIdx + 1 : (participantOrderRef.current.size + 1);
        participantOrderRef.current.set(chunk.speakerId, num);
      }
      speakerLabel = `Participant ${num} (${chunk.speakerName || 'Guest'})`;
    }

    const entry = {
      id: `${chunk.speakerId || 'spk'}_${chunk.timestamp || Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
      timestamp: chunk.timestamp || Date.now(),
      speakerId: chunk.speakerId,
      speakerLabel,
      speakerName: chunk.speakerName,
      isHost: Boolean(chunk.isHost),
      text: chunk.text
    };

    transcriptLogRef.current.push(entry);
    transcriptLogRef.current.sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp);
    setTranscriptEntries([...transcriptLogRef.current]);
  }, []);

  // ── 3. Handle data connection (PeerJS DataConnection) ─────────────────────
  const setupDataConnection = useCallback((conn) => {
    const peerId = conn.peer;
    dataConnsRef.current[peerId] = conn;

    conn.on('data', (data) => {
      if (!data || !data.type) return;

      switch (data.type) {
        // WebRTC Data Channel live speaker text chunk (BIT 2 & BIT 3)
        case 'speech_transcript': {
          handleIncomingSpeechChunk(data);
          break;
        }

        // Host receives knock from participant
        case 'knock': {
          setJoinRequests(prev => {
            if (prev.some(r => r.id === peerId)) return prev;
            return [...prev, { id: peerId, name: data.name || 'Guest' }];
          });
          break;
        }

        // Guest receives approval from host
        case 'knock_approved': {
          setIsWaitingForApproval(false);
          upsertPeer('__self__', { approved: true });

          // Call host or existing peers
          if (data.existingPeers && Array.isArray(data.existingPeers)) {
            data.existingPeers.forEach(ep => {
              if (ep.id !== peerInstanceRef.current?.id) {
                upsertPeer(ep.id, { name: ep.name, role: ep.role });
                if (streamRef.current && peerInstanceRef.current && !callsRef.current[ep.id]) {
                  const call = peerInstanceRef.current.call(ep.id, streamRef.current, {
                    sdpTransform: (sdp) => optimizeSdp(sdp, 500)
                  });
                  if (call) setupCall(call, ep.name, ep.role);
                }
              }
            });
          }
          break;
        }

        // Guest rejected by host
        case 'knock_rejected': {
          setIsWaitingForApproval(false);
          alert(data.message || 'Host declined your request to join the meeting.');
          onEndMeeting();
          break;
        }

        // Participant notified of another participant joining
        case 'participant_joined': {
          upsertPeer(data.peerId, { name: data.name, role: 'participant' });
          break;
        }

        // Audio, Video, Hand-raise state sync
        case 'peer_state': {
          upsertPeer(peerId, { [data.key]: data.value });
          break;
        }

        // Participant kicked by host
        case 'kicked': {
          alert('🚫 You have been removed from the meeting by the host.');
          onEndMeeting();
          break;
        }

        // Live Captions relay
        case 'live_caption': {
          setLiveCaption({ speaker: data.speaker, text: data.text, wpm: data.wpm });
          setTimeout(() => setLiveCaption(null), 4000);
          break;
        }

        default:
          break;
      }
    });

    conn.on('close', () => {
      console.log('[PeerJS] Data connection closed with:', peerId);
      removePeer(peerId);
    });

    conn.on('error', (err) => {
      console.warn('[PeerJS] Data conn error with:', peerId, err);
    });
  }, [upsertPeer, removePeer, setupCall, onEndMeeting, handleIncomingSpeechChunk]);

  // ── 4. Initialize PeerJS Client ───────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    let peer = null;
    let heartbeatInterval = null;

    const initPeer = async () => {
      const cleanCode = meetingCode.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').toUpperCase();
      const randomSuffix = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7);
      const myPeerId = `ge-${isGuest ? 'guest' : 'host'}-${cleanCode}-${randomSuffix}`;

      try {
        peer = new Peer(myPeerId, {
          ...PEER_OPTIONS,
          config: ADVANCED_RTC_CONFIG
        });
        peerInstanceRef.current = peer;

        peer.on('open', async (id) => {
          if (!alive) return;
          console.log('[PeerJS] Connected to signaling with ID:', id);
          setPeerStatus('open');

          // Keep signaling socket active with periodic heartbeat
          if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
          heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => {
            if (peer && !peer.destroyed && peer.socket && peer.socket._ws && peer.socket._ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
              try {
                peer.socket._ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'HEARTBEAT' }));
              } catch {}
            }
          }, 15000);

          if (!isGuest) {
            // Host creates / registers room in serverless room registry
            try {
              await roomApi('/api/rooms', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                  action: 'create',
                  code: meetingCode,
                  hostPeerId: id,
                  hostName: hostName || 'Host',
                  topic: meetingName || 'Strategy Sync'
                })
              });
              setIsWaitingForApproval(false);
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn('[Room Registry] Error creating room:', err.message);
              // Host can proceed even if backend registry had a temporary hiccup
              setIsWaitingForApproval(false);
            }
          } else {
            // Guest fetches room details to locate hostPeerId
            try {
              const res = await roomApi(`/api/rooms/${meetingCode}`, { method: 'GET' });
              const hostPeerId = res.hostPeerId || res.room?.hostPeerId;
              if (!hostPeerId) {
                alert('Meeting host is not currently in the room. Please check the code.');
                onEndMeeting();
                return;
              }

              // Establish DataConnection to host to knock
              const conn = peer.connect(hostPeerId, { reliable: true });
              conn.on('open', () => {
                conn.send({
                  type: 'knock',
                  peerId: id,
                  name: hostName || 'Guest'
                });
              });
              setupDataConnection(conn);
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn('[Room Registry] Join error:', err);
              alert('Could not join room. Please check the meeting code.');
              onEndMeeting();
            }
          }
        });

        // Listen for incoming data connections
        peer.on('connection', (conn) => {
          if (!alive) return;
          setupDataConnection(conn);
        });

        // Listen for incoming media calls
        peer.on('call', (call) => {
          if (!alive) return;
          console.log('[PeerJS] Incoming call from:', call.peer);
          // Answer with local media stream if available, applying H264/VP8 codec priority & 500kbps bitrate cap
          if (streamRef.current) {
            call.answer(streamRef.current, {
              sdpTransform: (sdp) => optimizeSdp(sdp, 500)
            });
          } else {
            // Answer with empty audio/video if camera not yet initialized
            call.answer(undefined, {
              sdpTransform: (sdp) => optimizeSdp(sdp, 500)
            });
          }
          setupCall(call, 'Participant', 'guest');
        });

        peer.on('error', (err) => {
          console.warn('[PeerJS] Client error:', err);
          if (err.type === 'peer-unavailable') {
            console.warn('[PeerJS] Target peer unavailable');
          } else if (err.type === 'disconnected' || err.type === 'network' || err.type === 'server-error' || err.type === 'socket-error') {
            if (!peer.destroyed) {
              setPeerStatus('connecting');
              setTimeout(() => {
                try {
                  if (!peer.destroyed && peer.disconnected) {
                    peer.reconnect();
                  }
                } catch (recErr) {}
              }, 1200);
            }
          }
        });

        peer.on('disconnected', () => {
          console.log('[PeerJS] Disconnected from server, attempting reconnect...');
          if (!peer.destroyed) {
            setPeerStatus('connecting');
            setTimeout(() => {
              try {
                if (!peer.destroyed && peer.disconnected) {
                  peer.reconnect();
                }
              } catch (recErr) {
                console.warn('[PeerJS] Reconnect attempt failed:', recErr);
              }
            }, 1000);
          }
        });

        peer.on('close', () => {
          setPeerStatus('error');
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[PeerJS] Failed to instantiate Peer:', err);
        setPeerStatus('error');
      }
    };

    initPeer();

    return () => {
      alive = false;
      if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
      Object.values(callsRef.current).forEach(c => { try { c.close(); } catch {} });
      Object.values(dataConnsRef.current).forEach(d => { try { d.close(); } catch {} });
      callsRef.current = {};
      dataConnsRef.current = {};
      if (peerInstanceRef.current) {
        try { peerInstanceRef.current.destroy(); } catch {}
        peerInstanceRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [meetingCode, isGuest, hostName, meetingName, setupCall, setupDataConnection, onEndMeeting]);

  // ── 5. Host Accept & Reject Participant Knock Actions ─────────────────────
  const acceptParticipant = useCallback(async (id) => {
    // Enforce 5-member limit (Host + 4 participants)
    if (peersRef.current.length >= 4) {
      alert('Room capacity reached (Maximum 5 members allowed). Cannot admit more participants.');
      return;
    }

    // Assign deterministic participant number upon admission
    if (!participantOrderRef.current.has(id)) {
      const nextNum = participantOrderRef.current.size + 1;
      participantOrderRef.current.set(id, nextNum);
    }

    // 1. Call room API to update registry
    try {
      await roomApi('/api/rooms', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: 'join',
          code: meetingCode,
          peerId: id,
          name: joinRequests.find(r => r.id === id)?.name || 'Guest'
        })
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Room join API note:', e);
    }

    // 2. Send knock_approved via data connection
    const conn = dataConnsRef.current[id];
    if (conn && conn.open) {
      const existingPeersList = peersRef.current.map(p => ({
        id: p.id,
        name: p.name,
        role: p.role
      }));
      // Include host in the list
      existingPeersList.push({
        id: peerInstanceRef.current?.id,
        name: hostName || 'Host',
        role: 'host'
      });

      conn.send({
        type: 'knock_approved',
        existingPeers: existingPeersList
      });
    }

    // 3. Initiate media call from Host to Participant with H.264/VP8 & 500kbps bitrate capping
    if (peerInstanceRef.current && streamRef.current) {
      const call = peerInstanceRef.current.call(id, streamRef.current, {
        sdpTransform: (sdp) => optimizeSdp(sdp, 500)
      });
      if (call) {
        const guestName = joinRequests.find(r => r.id === id)?.name || 'Guest';
        setupCall(call, guestName, 'participant');
      }
    }

    // 4. Notify other peers about the new participant
    broadcastData({
      type: 'participant_joined',
      peerId: id,
      name: joinRequests.find(r => r.id === id)?.name || 'Guest'
    });

    setJoinRequests(prev => prev.filter(r => r.id !== id));
  }, [meetingCode, joinRequests, hostName, setupCall, broadcastData]);

  const rejectParticipant = useCallback((id) => {
    const conn = dataConnsRef.current[id];
    if (conn && conn.open) {
      conn.send({
        type: 'knock_rejected',
        message: 'Host declined your request to join this meeting.'
      });
      setTimeout(() => {
        try { conn.close(); } catch {}
      }, 500);
    }
    setJoinRequests(prev => prev.filter(r => r.id !== id));
  }, []);

  // ── 6. Host Kick Participant Actions ──────────────────────────────────────
  const requestKick = useCallback((peer) => {
    setKickTarget(peer);
  }, []);

  const confirmKick = useCallback(() => {
    if (!kickTarget) return;
    const targetId = kickTarget.id;

    // Send kick message
    const conn = dataConnsRef.current[targetId];
    if (conn && conn.open) {
      conn.send({ type: 'kicked' });
    }

    removePeer(targetId);
    setKickTarget(null);
  }, [kickTarget, removePeer]);

  // ── 7. Control Toggles (Mic, Camera, Hand) ────────────────────────────────
  const toggleVideo = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!videoOn) {
      const currentVideoTracks = streamRef.current?.getVideoTracks() || [];
      if (currentVideoTracks.length > 0) {
        currentVideoTracks.forEach(t => { t.enabled = true; });
        setVideoOn(true);
        broadcastData({ type: 'peer_state', key: 'videoOn', value: true });
      } else {
        await startMedia();
      }
    } else {
      if (streamRef.current) {
        streamRef.current.getVideoTracks().forEach(t => { t.enabled = false; });
      }
      setVideoOn(false);
      broadcastData({ type: 'peer_state', key: 'videoOn', value: false });
    }
  }, [videoOn, broadcastData, startMedia]);

  const toggleAudio = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!audioOn) {
      const currentAudioTracks = streamRef.current?.getAudioTracks() || [];
      if (currentAudioTracks.length > 0) {
        currentAudioTracks.forEach(t => { t.enabled = true; });
        setAudioOn(true);
        broadcastData({ type: 'peer_state', key: 'audioOn', value: true });
      } else {
        await startMedia();
      }
    } else {
      if (streamRef.current) {
        streamRef.current.getAudioTracks().forEach(t => { t.enabled = false; });
      }
      setAudioOn(false);
      broadcastData({ type: 'peer_state', key: 'audioOn', value: false });
    }
  }, [audioOn, broadcastData, startMedia]);

  const toggleHandRaise = useCallback(() => {
    setHandRaised(prev => {
      const next = !prev;
      broadcastData({
        type: 'peer_state',
        key: 'handRaised',
        value: next
      });
      return next;
    });
  }, [broadcastData]);

  // ── 8. Speech Recognition & Telemetry ─────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
    if (!SR || !audioOn) return;

    let recognition;
    try {
      recognition = new SR();
      recognition.continuous = true;
      recognition.interimResults = false;
      recognition.lang = 'en-US';

      let lastTime = Date.now();
      recognition.onresult = (e) => {
        const transcript = e.results[e.results.length - 1][0].transcript.trim();
        if (!transcript) return;
        const words = transcript.split(/\s+/).length;
        const now = Date.now();
        const minElapsed = (now - lastTime) / 60000;
        lastTime = now;
        const wpm = minElapsed > 0 ? Math.min(Math.round(words / minElapsed), 220) : 130;
        const finalWpm = wpm > 40 ? wpm : 120;

        setLiveCaption({ speaker: hostName || 'You', text: transcript, wpm: finalWpm });
        setTimeout(() => setLiveCaption(null), 4000);

        broadcastData({
          type: 'live_caption',
          speaker: hostName || 'You',
          text: transcript,
          wpm: finalWpm
        });

        // ── WebRTC Data Channel for Live Identity Mapping (BIT 2 & BIT 3) ──
        const mySpeakerId = peerInstanceRef.current?.id || 'local_user';
        const mySpeakerName = hostName || (isGuest ? 'Guest' : 'Host');

        const speechPayload = {
          type: 'speech_transcript',
          speakerId: mySpeakerId,
          speakerName: mySpeakerName,
          isHost: !isGuest,
          text: transcript,
          timestamp: now
        };

        // Broadcast mapped speaker text chunk via WebRTC Data Channels
        broadcastData(speechPayload);

        // If this client is Host, aggregate locally into central log
        if (!isGuest) {
          handleIncomingSpeechChunk(speechPayload);
        }
      };
      recognition.onerror = () => {};
      recognition.start();
      recognitionRef.current = recognition;
    } catch {}

    return () => {
      try { if (recognition) recognition.stop(); } catch {}
    };
  }, [audioOn, hostName, isGuest, broadcastData, handleIncomingSpeechChunk]);

  // ── 9. Active Speaker Energy Detection (Web Audio Analyser) ───────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    let timer = null;
    let audioCtx = null;
    let localAnalyser = null;
    let localSource = null;
    const peerAnalysers = {};

    try {
      const AudioCtxClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (AudioCtxClass) {
        audioCtx = new AudioCtxClass();

        if (streamRef.current && streamRef.current.getAudioTracks().length > 0) {
          try {
            localSource = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(streamRef.current);
            localAnalyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
            localAnalyser.fftSize = 256;
            localAnalyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.3;
            localSource.connect(localAnalyser);
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        Object.entries(remoteStreamsRef.current).forEach(([pid, rStream]) => {
          if (rStream && rStream.getAudioTracks().length > 0) {
            try {
              const src = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(rStream);
              const ana = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
              ana.fftSize = 256;
              ana.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.3;
              src.connect(ana);
              peerAnalysers[pid] = { analyser: ana, source: src };
            } catch (e) {}
          }
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    const dataArr = new Uint8Array(128);
    let lastSwitchTime = Date.now();

    const monitorVolume = () => {
      if (!audioCtx) return;
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
        audioCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
      }

      let maxVol = 0;
      let candidateId = null;

      // 1. Local mic level
      if (localAnalyser && audioOnRef.current) {
        localAnalyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArr);
        let sum = 0;
